items.title_zh: FOMC鹰派阵营已占半数，沃什将沦为“跛脚鸭”主席？
items.summary_zh: 美联储主席沃什正面临一场罕见的权威危机：在鹰派委员逐步主导FOMC话语权的背景下，他若无法在会议沟通上重新掌握主动，或将被迫跟随多数而非引领方向

items.title: Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap leaves as shake-up at AI lab continues
items.summary: Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap announced his departure on Tuesday, the latest in a series of recent leadership shake-ups at the company.

items.summary_zh: OpenAI 资深高管 Brad Lightcap 于周二宣布离职，这是该公司近期一系列领导层变动中的最新一例。

items.title: Invitation Homes CEO says ban on institutional homebuying will bring down prices, but not immediately
items.summary: The CEO of the nation's largest single-family rental landlord said the new law banning large-scale investors from the market will lower prices in the long term.

items.summary_zh: 这家全美最大独户住宅租赁商的 CEO 表示，禁止大型投资者入市的新法长期将压低房价。

items.summary: OpenAI completed a roughly 7 billion dollar secondary tender, letting current and former employees cash out part of their stakes at an 852 billion dollar valuation.

items.title: Trump wants to split the MMR vaccine. Experts say that's unlikely — and comes with consequences
items.summary: Doctors and other experts say that splitting the measles, mumps and rubella shot has no scientific basis and is unlikely to get off the ground.
items.title_zh: 特朗普想把 MMR 疫苗拆分接种，专家称不太可能且后果堪忧
items.summary_zh: 医生等专家表示，拆分麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗缺乏科学依据，且不太可能落地。
